# B04 — Outline Review → First HTML Deck (Dev Implementation)

**Status:** Detailed; production enablement is gated by the product values below.  
**Outcome:** From one Chat: request → interview/brief → current Outline → revision → explicit confirmation → first HTML slide(s) published and previewed.  
**Specs:** UC-001 main + relevant alternatives, UC-003; FR-001, FR-003, FR-005, FR-007–008, FR-021–023, FR-113, FR-116–117, FR-124, FR-126–129; BR-003/011/013/017/018. Read complete spec including Main Flow and alternatives.  
**Decisions:** [ADR-0003](../adr/0003-tools-permissions.md), [0005](../adr/0005-deck-artifacts-revisions.md), [0007](../adr/0007-design-system-templates.md).

## 1. Scope / non-goals

**In:** Generation entrypoint, interview questions, accepted source/format/template/Design System choices, brief and Outline persistence, revision/confirmation, host-authorized deck creation, minimal HTML template/theme translator, one-to-few completed slides and safe Preview. **Out:** full multi-slide quality/research/images, partial recovery refinements (B05), editing after generation (B06), custom Design System editor (B07), other generation formats. B04 uses HTML as the first actual available format; BR-011's other categories do **not** imply support.

**Mandatory gate:** A model text such as “yes” is not authority to generate unless **Host** determines it is an unambiguous confirmation of the current displayed Outline + Brief (FR-003). An answer mixed with a change request must not confirm. Native CLI session and MCP tools cannot bypass this gate.

## 2. Code ownership / reuse

| Owner | Starting point | Deliverable |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/presentation/deck/` | `src/contracts.ts`, `src/outline-store.ts`, `src/index.ts`, `src/schema.ts` | Outline/Brief records, stable planned slides, confirmation and Deck metadata, revision API |
| `packages/presentation/design/` **new** | ADR-0007, OpenDesign tokens/templates reference | Local HTML built-in catalog, theme roles/default, layout candidates, theme snapshot |
| `packages/tools/presentation/` | `registerProposeOutline`, `registerPublishSlide` | Validated model-facing proposals/publishing via Host; no confirmation tool |
| `packages/host/api/` | Existing Host contract | Interview/review/confirm/generate admission and state projection |
| `apps/local-web/` + `packages/client/runtime/` | `outline-workflow.ts`, `outline-interaction.ts`, UI/preview assets | Show brief and outline, revision buttons, confirmation, Deck canvas |
| `apps/local-web/src/opencode/` | B02/B03 | Run-scoped skill/prompt and tool permission by phase; no new Agent Loop |

## 3. Dev tasks

### B04-IMP-01 — Resolve small visual catalog required for first deck

- Before claiming theme/template/default behavior, settle **BR-003 V-1** (built-in default Design System), **BR-017 V-1** (named theme roles), **BR-018 V-1/V-2** (available HTML templates and default) and update product specs. BR-018 permits one HTML template in Phase 0. Keep those choices versioned and available offline.
- Implement a narrow `DesignSystem` theme contract and `Template(format='html', layouts, contentKinds, capacity)`. Host selects compatible layouts; Agent fills chosen layout. If none fit, model may propose a new layout under same theme and must pass publication checks.
- **Do not:** invent arbitrary role names in implementation without updating rule; require B07 custom editor to exist first; copy all OpenDesign templates or theme tiers.
- **Developer checks:** unknown template/format refused; complete theme values; compatible layout selection and fallback path deterministic; default chosen from catalog only.

### B04-IMP-02 — Interview and Brief state

- From request + material, identify unanswered interview topics required by BR-013 (topic, audience, time, purpose, source, language, images, format, template, design system). Ask grouped questions with suggested answers/skip; preserve user answers and explicit assumptions. A clarification question ends its request; next user answer starts new request (FR-014).
- Persist current Brief and inputs in Chat state; don't send every answer back into a different Chat. Do not silently replace an unavailable generation format with HTML when the user explicitly chose another unavailable one.
- **Developer checks:** full/already answered/missing topics; skip behavior; requested unsupported format; source selection unchanged after UI reload; no slide published during interview.

### B04-IMP-03 — Outline proposal, revision and confirmation

- Reuse `OutlineStorage` ideas: Host generates `outlineId`, `version`, stable `slideId`; model supplies only content. Persist current and earlier proposals; UI shows full Outline **with Brief** before confirmation. Revision supersedes current proposal but does not delete conversation history.
- Confirmation uses **current version/id + explicit confirm** only; confirm and Deck creation are atomic. Empty/stale/mixed confirm rejected or treated as revision, never silently allowed. Lock selected generation format **when slide generation begins**, even when no slide published (FR-116).
- **Developer checks:** version conflict/stale confirm, empty Outline, revise then confirm, duplicate confirmation idempotence, no pre-confirm publish, restart retains pending Outline.

### B04-IMP-04 — HTML source staging and first publish

- Host-owned managed staging path; scoped `publishSlide` validates Chat, confirmed outline/format, allowed slide ID, expected revision, publication ID, artifact safety and theme. Preserve last-good published revision; do not expose scratch or half-written files in Preview.
- Adapt legacy `DeckService` revision/publication logic; move large HTML/assets to managed filesystem with SQLite metadata/pointers per ADR-0005. Commit file then update metadata safely, with cleanup/recovery for incomplete stage; keep source folder untouched.
- **Developer checks:** duplicate publication same ID returns same receipt; conflicting revision rejected; failed stage leaves previous revision; source folder unchanged; malicious HTML/script/reference rejected by actual HTML safety contract.

### B04-IMP-05 — Preview and minimal Agent skill

- UI renders published HTML in a sandboxed viewer; lists pending/finished planned slides without changing user's selected slide. Host supplies effective theme/template snapshot to the generation run. Version the minimal generation skill/prompt alongside code, not as ad-hoc chat instructions.
- **Developer checks:** Outline first, no slide preview before confirm; after confirm published slide available; reload shows same finished slide and locked format; no raw internal file paths exposed to browser.

## 4. Developer integration checks

- **Happy-path integration:** Chat request → interview answer(s) → Brief + Outline → explicit confirm → first HTML slide → Preview → restart/reopen. Use real OpenCode CLI for one smoke; deterministic fake/tool fixtures for repeated checks.
- **Negative checks:** Stale outline, mixed confirmation/change, unsupported format, source cannot be read, malicious/pending slide publication, HTML failed stage, duplicate publish, no project-folder mutation.
- **Architectural check:** Only Host UI confirmation calls `confirmOutline`; MCP tools cannot call it. An Agent cannot publish before confirmed state even with forged `outlineId`.
- Run relevant existing `tests/outline-state.test.mjs`, `tests/outline-workflow.test.mjs`, `tests/deck-service.test.mjs`, `tests/publish-slide.test.mjs` as references, plus affected `node --test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`.

## 5. Dependencies / Done / B05 handoff

B02 provides real request/CLI/events; B03 provides input/source/MCP grants. B04-IMP-01 can start in parallel with Outline contracts, but **cannot** finish until BR-003/017/018 are set. Assign one integrator for DeckService and presentation tools; different agents should not independently implement a second Deck repository.

**Dev Done:** a complete, persisted first HTML deck path works; no slide can be built before confirm; format/theme snapshot locked, published artifact durable and preview safe. Not a claim of full Deck quality or independent UC pass.

**Handoff:** effective theme/template schema, `outlineId`/version, `slideId`, publication and preview contracts, generation phase tool grants, limitations to resolve in B05.
